source: M original even-native IID full frequency pairs and uniform integer-embedded secret in Z_(3^r)^n; conditional high lifts remain uniform given all low prefixes.
claim: Arbitrary collective measurements whose effective POVM depends only on label residues modulo3^ell have raw mean least-trit advantage at most sqrt(((5/3)^M-1)/3^(n(r-ell)))+(1-3^(-M))/3^(n(r-ell)), capped at2/3, with unlimited full-label final classical decoding.
proof_obligations: Externally review the conditional A2 character covariance and residue/sign block argument over composite ternary roots.
Review tensor fourth-moment induction, positive-effect spectral extension and weighted three-class transfer.
Charge every high-kernel secret and every source abort; do not condition correctness on their removal.
Verify the ENTIRE effective quantum measurement is unchanged by higher-label variations preserving the low prefix.
Do not confuse a low-controlled coupling matrix with an echo whose other gates use full frequencies.
Validate all ideal-source joint-error, source supply and upstream reduction obligations separately.
Do not infer a polynomial-copy impossibility from a near-entropy copy bound or a passed necessary gate.
Check novelty externally; finite algebraic certificates do not prove the general theorem.
falsifiers: A nonkernel covariance crosses residue/sign blocks.
A positive complete effect violates the stated tensor variance bound.
A lawful low-prefix collective measurement and decoder exceed the raw source-average weak bound.
A full-label-controlled circuit or filtered non-IID source is declared to be covered.
Kernel omission, floating underflow or a full-label information-only PGM score is promoted to a speedup.
explicit_escapes: More charged polynomial copies can make the bound vacuous.
Higher-label quantum control, including full-frequency phase gates.
Different source or secret prior with separately justified access and reductions.
